name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 11 Nov
state: The UK national terrorism threat level is Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, after the Joint Terrorism Analysis Centre raised it from Substantial on 30 Apr 2026 (ProtectUK). Searches on 11 Nov found no change to the level.
for_you: Counter Terrorism Policing asks the public to stay alert and report suspicious activity to police or via its online reporting service; in an emergency call 999. ProtectUK publishes guidance for venues and businesses.
